headline_marked: Spain 1-0 Portugal: [[Spain reach quarter-finals]] as Ronaldo's World Cup career ends
headline: Spain 1-0 Portugal: Spain reach quarter-finals as Ronaldo's World Cup career ends
summary: A late strike by Mikel Merino sinks Portugal, marking the emotional final World Cup match for 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo.
details: Spain secured a 1-0 victory over Portugal in a tense last-16 encounter, advancing to the quarter-finals of the World Cup. The decisive goal was scored by substitute Mikel Merino in the first minute of injury time, assisted by Ferran Torres.

The match, played before 70,649 fans in Dallas, remained scoreless for the majority of the game. Spain dominated much of the pressure, while Portugal struggled to find a breakthrough despite several attempts by Cristiano Ronaldo.
For 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo, this match marked his final World Cup appearance. The Portuguese captain had previously confirmed that this would be his 'last dance' on football's biggest stage.
Spain will now face either the United States or Belgium in the quarter-finals on Friday in Los Angeles. They continue their strong form, having not conceded a goal throughout the tournament so far.
The game also featured a poignant moment before kickoff, as a tribute was paid to the late Portugal forward Diogo Jota on the giant screen.
The clash was billed as a showdown between the legendary Ronaldo and Spain's 18-year-old prodigy Lamine Yamal, representing two extraordinary talents at opposite ends of their careers.
caption:
The end of an era. 💔

Spain's late winner knocks out Portugal and ends Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup journey.

Spain secured a 1-0 victory over Portugal in a tense last-16 encounter, advancing to the quarter-finals of the World Cup. The decisive goal was scored by substitute Mikel Merino in the first minute of injury time, assisted by Ferran Torres.

The match, played before 70,649 fans in Dallas, remained scoreless for the majority of the game. Spain dominated much of the pressure, while Portugal struggled to find a breakthrough despite several attempts by Cristiano Ronaldo.

For 41-year-old Cristiano Ronaldo, this match marked his final World Cup appearance. The Portuguese captain had previously confirmed that this would be his 'last dance' on football's biggest stage.

Spain will now face either the United States or Belgium in the quarter-finals on Friday in Los Angeles. They continue their strong form, having not conceded a goal throughout the tournament so far.

The game also featured a poignant moment before kickoff, as a tribute was paid to the late Portugal forward Diogo Jota on the giant screen.

The clash was billed as a showdown between the legendary Ronaldo and Spain's 18-year-old prodigy Lamine Yamal, representing two extraordinary talents at opposite ends of their careers.

headline: 200 illegal immigrants including Bangladeshis detained in Malaysia
summary: Malaysian authorities conducted a raid on an evening market, leading to the mass detention of undocumented workers.
details: Malaysian authorities have detained 200 illegal immigrants, including several Bangladeshi nationals, during a raid on an evening market.
The operation was part of a broader effort to crack down on undocumented foreign workers operating within the country.
The detainees are currently being processed for further legal action and potential deportation back to their home countries.
In a separate development, Malaysia is establishing 'transit centers' to provide temporary housing and better protection for foreign workers.
Additionally, three Bangladeshi citizens were arrested in Malaysia for allegedly kidnapping and robbing an expatriate while posing as police officers.
